headline: Any agent, any model: pick who drafts and who reviews
pill: any agent and model in either seat, and Gemini in preview
summary: Turnhuddle is no longer just Claude and Codex. A conversation has two seats, a drafter and a reviewer, and each can be Claude Code, Codex or (in preview) the Gemini CLI, with any model you have. The picker lists the models found on your machine.

highlights.title: Choose the agent and model for each seat
highlights.text: The two names under the message box are the seats. Click one for a picker like Claude Code's: every provider, the models found on your machine (the Codex models your account offers, Claude's aliases and the models you've used recently, Gemini's), **Other model…** for any id, and **Swap drafter and reviewer**. Seat the same provider twice with two models if you like. The choice applies to the open conversation and to new ones.
highlights.alt: The agent picker for the reviewer seat, listing Claude, Codex and Gemini models with the current choice checked, and Swap drafter and reviewer at the end

highlights.title: Every message says which model wrote it
highlights.text: Agent names in the chat include the model, in the provider's colour, so a conversation whose seats changed still shows who said what. Prompts introduce each agent by name and seat.
highlights.alt: A Turnhuddle conversation between Claude Opus 5.5 and Codex GPT-6.2-Sol that ends with both agreeing

improvements: **Gemini CLI (preview).** Seat Gemini in either role once the `gemini` CLI is installed and signed in. It's built against the CLI's documented streaming output and tested with recorded output; please report how it works for you.
Built for more providers: each one is a single entry in a registry, so adding the next CLI doesn't touch the chat, history or prompts.
The composer is calmer: the seats, the mode and Send. The round status appears while a round runs, and each seat's tooltip shows its model and effort; **Effort and other settings…** is in the picker.

New commands: **Choose the Drafter's Agent and Model**, **Choose the Reviewer's Agent and Model** and **Swap Drafter and Reviewer**. New settings: `turnhuddle.drafter`, `turnhuddle.reviewer` and `turnhuddle.geminiPath`.
**Check CLI Installations** lists every provider, marking the ones you don't use as optional.
fixes: Conversations from earlier versions open unchanged: Claude's messages are the drafter's and Codex's the reviewer's.
